svg.title: Mission Control concept with synthetic data
svg.desc: A concept of an overall dashboard across several projects, with synthetic data. It shows navigation and components; a Mission Control summary with 6 projects, 12 AI agents and 247 tasks verified in 24 hours; work under way in 4 projects and one decision waiting for a person; an AI coordinator's proposed Docs Site release decision; progress for verified tasks, 262 of 275 reviews passed, current evidence and agents in use; AI agent work, review results and evidence status; task throughput, agent load up 8 points on yesterday and agent slots; six projects and six recent activities.
